name: PCB TestKit
description: Production test & assembly: weak-point analysis, fab class checks, test plan, pogo-pin fixture PCB, solder jig, explainer.
description_full:
PCB TestKit reads the open board and schematic and prepares everything needed to build and test it in production.

- Weak-point analysis: manufacturability, assembly, test access and life-cycle risks, with locations.
- Technology classes: checks the board against fab class systems (Eurocircuits, JLCPCB, PCBWay, OSH Park, AISLER, Wurth) and IPC-2221 voltage spacing / IPC-6012 rings, and tells you the cheapest class to order.
- Good-unit specification (JSON) and a test scheme with limits per net.
- Pogo-pin fixture board generated as a KiCad PCB, with probes placed under real test points.
- 3D-printable solder jig (STL + OpenSCAD) for the hand-soldered parts.
- Raspberry Pi / MCU test runner, an HTML report and a visual step-by-step guide with KiCad 3D renders.
- Optional explainer video: real 3D animation rendered with KiCad (assembly, jig, fixture, test).

Everything runs locally with the Python standard library and KiCad's own kicad-cli. The same engine has a command line, a JSON tool API and an MCP server so AI assistants can drive it.
